title: security(rbac-v2): enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Background and motivation: our RBAC v2 rollout must ensure that user-specified KMS keys and region pins cannot be used to bypass data residency controls. This PR enforces KMS region pinning at the policy evaluation layer, expands audit log coverage for KMS operations, and hardens the RBAC v2 enforcement paths to emit deterministic audit entries for policy decisions.

What this change does (summary): 1) Adds KMS region residency checks during policy evaluation and rejects key usages that violate customer or org-level residency constraints. 2) Emits structured audit events for all KMS key lookup, decrypt/encrypt and region-resolution steps (new audit fields: kms_key_id, requested_region, resolved_region, policy_decision, evaluated_by). 3) Introduces a feature-flag rbac.v2.enforce_kms_region_pinning (default: enabled for enterprise tenants, opt-in for others during migration). 4) Adds migration/compatibility shim to ensure existing keys are validated without downtime. 5) End-to-end tests and integration tests covering cross-region key attempts and fallback behavior.

Checklist: - [x] Policy evaluation code + unit tests - [x] Audit event schema and logger changes - [x] Feature flag gating + console exposure - [x] Migration shim and rollout doc - [x] Integration & e2e test coverage - [x] Security review signoff

Rollout plan: enable feature-flag for internal orgs and enterprise customers first, monitor audit events and policy denies for 72h, then gradually enable for high-usage tenants. In case of false positives, operators can toggle the feature-flag per-tenant while the migration shim logs warnings rather than denies for 24h windows.

Compatibility notes: this is backwards compatible with the RBAC v2 policy AST; an additional policy predicate is introduced (kms_region_residency) but existing policies without it will continue to evaluate. We added an explicit deny-if-missing-residency flag for owners who want strict defaults.

References: Linear ENG-4321, security spec doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4321/kms-region-pinning, internal runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-region-residency.md

Testing: added 8 new unit test files, 3 integration scenarios in perf-canary harness, and an e2e test that simulates cross-region KMS key use and verifies audit events and deny paths. CI: initial run had a flaky integration test (timing-related); fixed by increasing test harness timeout and mocking region-resolve RPC. All checks now pass.
